name: Modal lightbox
purpose: The viewer member of the modal family: shows a thing (statement page, cheque image, document preview) rather than asking a question. Inherits the dialog mechanics from Modals — dim scrim, trapped focus, Escape, inert page, focus return — and adds a captioned stage with previous/next navigation. Extends Modals as a separate snippet (fence); the receipt proposes the eventual family fold.

props.name: items
props.$note: The viewable set; each item = media + caption. Counter announces position ('1 of 3').

props.name: label
props.$note: Dialog accessible name via aria-label (e.g. 'Statement viewer').

variants.name: document
variants.use: Multi-page statement/document preview with page captions.

variants.name: image
variants.use: Single or few images (cheque deposit, ID capture review); prev/next hidden when single.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — caption .t-ed-body-small; counter .t-cm-legal
tokens.tiles: controls + caption sit on tertiary/background/default tiles with elevation/border + elevation/functional shadow — never bare on the scrim (token-clean contrast; no white-on-scrim type, type26-013)
tokens.controls: Icon-button geometry (44×44, 18px glyph icon/default); colour-only states pending button-family partial injection (ADR-0013)
tokens.media: decorative placeholder gradient tertiary/background/hover → button/primary/background/disabled (neutral greys, aria-hidden; consumers supply real imagery)

motion.entry: Overlay fades (motion/duration/fade); stage does not transform.

responsive.rule: Stage max-width 720px, fluid below; media 400px → 280px at ≤560px; controls keep the 44px target at every size.

mustNotNeighbour: An open Modals dialog or Drawer (one modal surface at a time)
commonPatterns: document preview from a list row

accessibility.role: role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" + aria-label; caption bar is role="status" (polite) so page changes announce.
accessibility.name: aria-label names the viewer; every control has an aria-label; media placeholders aria-hidden (captions carry the information).
accessibility.keyboard: Focus trapped; ← → navigate pages; Esc closes; focus returns to trigger; ends disable their control (no wrap — position stays truthful).
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible (focus/ring) on all controls; first focus lands on close.

antiPatterns: Controls or captions bare on the scrim (contrast unguaranteed; white-on-scrim type breaks type26-013)
Backdrop blur (dim preserves page glance — Modals ruling)
Wrapping prev/next silently (position lies; disable at the ends)
Meaning carried by the media alone (captions are mandatory)
A lightbox for a yes/no decision (that is the Modals dialog)
Re-implementing press physics locally on the controls (ADR-0013 ratchet)

tokenValidation.against: token store (semantic-colour.json) via #token-manifest — dialog bindings mirror Modals (gated green)
tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; declared pairs 21:1/16.9:1 both modes.
tokenValidation.$note: Built Phase-2 wave 1 (worker B). Controls await button-family $members registration (--phys-size:44); receipt proposes the modal-family fold.

items.use: The documents or images the viewer pages through.
items.$status: ruled s140-D2 (Dave, 2026-08-09, via SLOTS-DRAFT-REVIEW s140-v1 export)

mustNotNeighbour.$note: An open Modals dialog or Drawer (one modal surface at a time)
